summary_en: Daicel authorized acquisition of up to 5.6 million shares (2.19% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 8 billion yen through November 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027, via market purchases and ToSTNeT-3 transactions, with acquired shares to be cancelled except those needed for restricted stock awards.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, Daicel Corporation's board of directors authorized the acquisition of its own shares under the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 5.6 million shares, representing 2.19% of outstanding shares (calculated from 255,690,075 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum total of 8 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 10, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The buyback will be executed through two methods: open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and off-auction trades via ToSTNeT-3. The company stated that the acquisition is undertaken as part of its medium-term capital allocation strategy to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.

Acquired shares will be cancelled, except for those retained to satisfy obligations under restricted stock award and restricted stock incentive programs. As of September 30, 2026, Daicel held 452,607 treasury shares.
